data.narrative:
Swan is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Dima Kislovskiy and Narek Melik Barkhudarov, having raised $38.5M to date. The valuation framework incorporates a comp universe of 10 private firms (including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI) and 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression, using total raised as a proxy base, applies a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier to the $38M raised, implying a $96M valuation. Peer-Median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a $400M median valuation, with a range of $125M–$1.0B. The peer set reflects material heterogeneity in stage and funding maturity, evident in the $875M spread between NODA AI ($125M Series A) and UFORCE ($1.0B Seed).

Triangulation across both methods produces a low of $82M, median of $248M, and high of $460M. This wide range reflects substantive uncertainty around Swan's growth trajectory relative to peers and the stage-appropriate discount to more mature Defense & Security companies. The applicability of both methods is limited by sparse comparable data at early seed and the structural variance in peer funding timing. Key uncertainties center on revenue traction, customer concentration, and technology differentiation relative to the identified comp set.
